create_CameraSensor: create a CameraSensor instance with custom resolution, fov, and camera mode for robot vision
change_mounting_point: change the camera mounting point by setting new translation, rotation, and parent link id
set_robot: set the robot on the CameraSensor to initialize the mounted camera with pybullet client
project_depth_map_to_point_cloud: project a depth map to a 3D point cloud in world or robot frame
get_original_observation: get the original camera observation with timestamp and rendered image data
